description: Approval of one Auto Email Report that touches data governed by Access Rules. The engine writes it when a System Manager saves the record. Without a matching approval the record does not run.

fields.description: Name of the Auto Email Report record this approval belongs to.
fields.label: Auto Email Report

fields.description: System Manager who saved the record by hand. Saving is the approval.
fields.label: Approved By

fields.description: When the System Manager saved the record.
fields.label: Approved On

fields.description: Fingerprint of the record's settings at approval: report, user, recipients, filters and the rest. The record runs only while its settings still match.
fields.label: Settings Digest

name: Auto Email Report Approval
